question: The National Lata Mangeshkar Award 2021 was given to:
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Kumar Sanu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Lata Mangeshkar Award** is a prestigious award given in honor of the legendary Indian playback singer, Lata Mangeshkar.
 
• The award is conferred by the **Government of Madhya Pradesh** to recognize outstanding contributions to Indian music.
 
• **Kumar Sanu**, a renowned playback singer in Bollywood, was honored with the National Lata Mangeshkar Award in **2021**.
 
• Kumar Sanu is known for his melodious voice and has sung numerous hit songs in the **1990s** and early **2000s**.
 
• He holds the **Guinness World Record** for recording the most songs in a single day, achieving this feat in **1993**.
 
• His contributions to Indian music have earned him multiple awards, including **Filmfare Awards** for Best Male Playback Singer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sonu Nigam**__

 __
 
• **Sonu Nigam** is another famous Indian playback singer known for his versatility and soulful voice.
 
• He has sung songs in various languages, including Hindi, Kannada, and Tamil.
 
• Sonu Nigam has won numerous awards, including the **National Film Award** for Best Male Playback Singer.
 
 
 
• **Udit Narayan**__
 __
 
• **Udit Narayan** is a celebrated playback singer in Indian cinema, particularly known for his work in Bollywood.
 
• He has received multiple **Filmfare Awards** and a **Padma Bhushan**, India's third-highest civilian award.
 
• Udit Narayan has sung in over 36 languages.
 
 
 
• **Arijit Singh**__
 
 
• **Arijit Singh** is a contemporary Indian playback singer known for his emotive and soulful voice.
 
• He gained widespread fame with the song "**Tum Hi Ho**" from the movie **Aashiqui 2**.
 
• Arijit Singh has won numerous awards, including several **Filmfare Awards**.
